title: The Community Garden Debate: Privacy, Technology, and Social Change
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选、填空、匹配（用单选形式）和判断正误/未提及。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有问题用英语作答。语法部分先看中文讲解，再完成8道新题。口语和写作任务为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. In the small town of Riverton, a community garden was created five years ago. At first, only ten families used it. They grew vegetables and shared tools. Last year, the town council decided to add new technology: a website where people could book garden plots online, and a camera to watch the garden at night. The council said this would help more people use the garden safely. However, some gardeners were not happy. They worried that the camera would record their faces and that their personal information might be shared. Maria, a gardener for three years, said, “I think that the camera is a good idea for safety, but I am not sure that everyone understands how the website works.”

B. The council organized a meeting to discuss the changes. At the meeting, Tom, a council member, explained, “We believe that the website will make booking easier. The camera will only record when there is movement at night. We will not share your information with anyone.” Some gardeners asked questions. “What happens if the camera records my children playing?” asked one parent. Tom replied, “The camera only works at night, so it will not record children during the day.” Another gardener, Ahmed, said, “I think that we need a clear rule about who can see the recordings. If we don’t have a rule, people will worry.” The council agreed to write a privacy policy.

C. After the meeting, the council wrote a policy. It said that only the garden manager could see the recordings, and only if there was a problem, such as a theft. The recordings would be deleted after seven days. The policy also said that the website would not ask for more information than necessary: just a name and an email address. When gardeners read the policy, most felt better. Maria said, “Now I understand that the council listened to us. I think that the policy is fair.” Ahmed added, “If the council keeps its promise, we can trust the technology.” The garden now has fifty families, and the website is used every day. The council plans to add more gardens in other parts of town, but they promise to ask the community first.

D. This story shows how technology can change a community. It also shows that people need to talk about privacy and rules. When people discuss their worries and listen to each other, they can find solutions that work for everyone. The gardeners in Riverton learned that new technology is not just about machines; it is also about people and their trust.

grammar.title: 名词性从句入门：that 从句与情态动词/条件表达
grammar.explanation: 英语中，有些动词后面可以跟一个由 that 引导的句子，这个句子整体充当动词的宾语，叫做宾语从句。例如：I think that the camera is a good idea. 这里 that 没有实际意思，只起连接作用，口语中常省略。注意从句要用陈述语序，即使原句是疑问句，变成从句时也要用陈述语序，如：What does he want? → I don't know what he wants. 另外，情态动词（can, could, will, would, should, might 等）表示可能性、能力、建议等；条件句用 if 引导，表示“如果……”。例如：If we don't have a rule, people will worry. 条件句主句常用 will 或情态动词。
grammar.example: I think that the camera is a good idea for safety, but I am not sure that everyone understands how the website works.

options: I think that she is right.
I think that is she right.
I think that she right.
answers: I think that she is right.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句要用陈述语序，且不能省略系动词。A选项语序正确，B选项是疑问语序，C选项缺少系动词。
questions.evidence: I think that the camera is a good idea for safety

options: He said that he would come.
He said that would he come.
He said that he will come yesterday.
answers: He said that he would come.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序，且主句是过去时，从句常用过去将来时would。A正确，B语序错误，C时态不一致。
questions.evidence: The council said this would help more people use the garden safely.

options: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it will rain, we stay at home.
If it rains, we would stay at home.
answers: If it rains, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 条件句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时（will）。A正确，B从句用了will，C主句用了would（与现在事实相反时用）。
questions.evidence: If we don’t have a rule, people will worry.

options: She might be at home now.
She might is at home now.
She might at home now.
answers: She might be at home now.
questions.explanation: 情态动词might后接动词原形，be是原形。A正确，B用了is，C缺少动词。
questions.evidence: their personal information might be shared

options: I don't know what he wants.
I don't know what does he want.
I don't know what he want.
answers: I don't know what he wants.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序，且主语he是第三人称单数，动词用wants。A正确，B是疑问语序，C动词形式错误。
questions.evidence: I am not sure that everyone understands how the website works.

options: The teacher said that the earth goes around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth went around the sun.
The teacher said that does the earth go around the sun.
answers: The teacher said that the earth goes around the sun.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句表示客观真理时，即使主句是过去时，从句仍用一般现在时。A正确，B时态错误，C语序错误。
questions.evidence: We believe that the website will make booking easier.

options: If you study hard, you can pass the exam.
If you study hard, you could pass the exam.
If you will study hard, you can pass the exam.
answers: If you study hard, you can pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 条件句if从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词can表示能力。A正确，B用了could（表示可能性较小或虚拟），C从句用了will。
questions.evidence: If the council keeps its promise, we can trust the technology.

options: I am not sure that he will join us.
I am not sure that will he join us.
I am not sure that he joins us tomorrow.
answers: I am not sure that he will join us.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序，且表示将来用will。A正确，B语序错误，C时态错误。
questions.evidence: I am not sure that everyone understands how the website works.
